BiblicalUsage: Choled is a weasel, named once among the creeping things the law calls unclean. It runs in the list with the mouse and the tortoise, small creatures that defile by their touch, and the law marks them so that Israel will learn to tell clean from unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a weasel in the law teaches me that God cares about the small things of holiness.
